Note: the job description could not be read (status: blocked), so this summary is built from the resume text alone and cannot yet be matched against specific JD requirements.

# summary of work history blurb

Jane Doe is an AI-Native Builder and technical program leader with roughly two decades spanning enterprise delivery and independent product work. Since August 2014 at Cairenes Solutions he has shipped products by directing AI rather than hand-coding, maintaining a 10+ open-source lineage (github.com/janedoe) — apps like addypin, ownsub, late.fyi and signedreply, plus libraries such as knowless and bare-suite. Earlier builds (Sharity MVP) taught sunk-cost discipline, MVP focus and minimalism. Before that, a decade of embedded delivery: at Liberty Global (2024–2025) he built unified Jira/PowerBI dashboards across 6 EU markets, created P1–P4 defect density and MTTR reporting, and implemented lightweight governance across MSP handoffs. At Meta (2022–2023) he scaled academic researcher onboarding and privacy compliance (DSA, UK GDPR, FTC). At Cognizant (2019–2020) he modernized a dormant platform to microservices and trained Agile cohorts. At Vodafone (2005–2014) he led roaming expansion from 100 to 190 countries, doubling annual rollout capacity and cutting complaints 80%.

# professional skills

Professional skills span several clusters. AI building and automation: generative and agentic AI, AI-assisted development that ships prototypes without an engineering team, prompt engineering, rapid prototyping, and low-code/no-code automation. Consulting and delivery: AI adoption and enablement, change management, program and project management, product operations, requirements and data analysis, plus cross-functional leadership and influence. Tools: Jira (Structure, Dashboards), Confluence, PowerBI and Google Suite. Domains include telecom/roaming, social media, consulting, systems thinking and emerging-tech research (AI and cognitive science), with light privacy and regulatory compliance. Applied evidence: roaming innovation (100→190 countries), Agile/Scrum enablement, cloud migration (monolithic to microservices), and cross-market delivery reporting across six EU markets. Credentials: Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO); Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Egyptian Aviation Academy. Languages: Arabic (native) and English (fluent). These are drawn from the resume only, not yet matched to the JD.

# soft skills

Soft skills evidenced throughout the resume: simple-over-clever judgment and minimalism — shipping the few features that carry a product and cutting the rest; sunk-cost discipline learned from early product wins and failures. Leadership without formal authority: managing 15+ distributed team members across US, Switzerland, India, Poland, Romania, Hungary and Luxembourg, extracting quality work by understanding constraints, cultural differences and autonomy. Cross-cultural, distributed collaboration with contractors across South Asia and US/EU. Curiosity and pattern recognition: intentionally working across social impact, map localization, roaming, NLP, agent memory and context engineering to spot unsolved problems, including Aurora Framework research on reasoning gaps in agentic AI. Self-directed learning: self-taught advanced Jira and PowerBI to make invisible systems visible and drive accountability within four months. Communication and enablement: training engineering cohorts on Agile/Scrum, onboarding researchers on privacy compliance, and influencing VPs by escalating cadence gaps. Pragmatism under constraints: facilitating roaming and SMS market-entry strategy workshops under regulatory and geopolitical limits. Drawn from the resume alone; the JD was unreadable, so no JD-specific tailoring was possible.
